claudes take
```
Before devnet-1 runs, ethpandaops needs to:

 * regenerate genesis VRF roots and the vrf_state_url files with the new leaf rule (the eth-beacon-genesis change is small, about 20 lines in vrf.go). Until they do, Teku blocks built from this branch won't pass process_randao;
 * confirm devnet-1's spec pin is 4c296784;
* fill in the Teku row on the devnet-1 notes page: branch pq-devnet-1, image still to be decided.
```
